name: Historic Battlefield Trail
addr: Brownsville Events Center, 1 Event Center Dr, Brownsville, TX
parking: Big free lots at the Brownsville Events Center off Paredes Line Rd. Also at Linear Park on E 6th St (by the courthouse) and the Palo Alto Battlefield visitor center.
note: Flat with little shade. Go early and bring water.

name: Paseo de la Resaca Trail
addr: Texas Trail of Trees Park, Brownsville, TX
parking: Park at Texas Trail of Trees Park, North Park, or the Brownsville Events Center.
note: Runs along the resacas through north Brownsville. Leash required.

name: Rose M.Z. Gowen Trail
addr: Prax Orive (Sunrise) Park, 1245 Palm Blvd, Brownsville, TX
parking: Lot at Prax Orive (Sunrise) Park on W 1st St, off W Van Buren St. Also at Linear Park on E 6th St.
note: Old rail line, flat and easy.

name: Resaca de la Palma State Park
addr: 1000 New Carmen Ave, Brownsville, TX 78521
miles: 2.8 mile loop, plus about 10 miles of short nature trails
surface: Tram Loop is paved. Other trails are dirt.
parking: Park at the visitor center. No cars past that point. $4 per adult, kids 12 and under free.
note: Open 6 AM to 10 PM. Keep dogs leashed and bring water for them.

name: Monte Bella Park
addr: 2485 W Alton Gloor Blvd, Brownsville, TX
parking: Lot at the park entrance on W Alton Gloor Blvd.
note: Shared with mountain bikers, so keep your pup close.

name: Catherine B. Stillman Dog Park
addr: 416 FM 511, Olmito, TX 78575
note: Fenced. Separate big and small dog areas, benches, shade trees, and water.

name: Sweet St Dog Park
addr: 2843 Sweet St, Brownsville, TX 78521
note: Small fenced area, good for a quick run.

name: The Broken Sprocket
addr: 6305 Paredes Line Rd, Brownsville, TX 78526
note: Food truck park with outdoor tables and its own dog park.

name: Cobbleheads
addr: 3154 Central Blvd, Brownsville, TX 78520
note: Outdoor table by the water.

name: 7th and Park
addr: 1554 E 7th St, Brownsville, TX 78520
note: Coffee and bike shop with outdoor tables.

name: Rudy's Country Store and Bar-B-Q
addr: 2780 N Expressway, Brownsville, TX 78526
note: Outdoor table. No table service, so someone stays outside with the dog while you order.

name: Arroyo Colorado Hike & Bike Trail
addr: McKelvey Park, 1325 S 77 Sunshine Strip, Harlingen, TX
parking: Paved lots at McKelvey Park (1325 S 77 Sunshine Strip), Harlingen Thicket (311 E Taft), Arroyo Park (New Hampshire St and Hale St), and C.B. Wood Park (400 W Harding Ave).
note: Restrooms and water at McKelvey Park and Arroyo Park. Can get muddy after rain.

name: Meg Jorn Trail
addr: Hugh Ramsey Nature Park, 1000 S Loop 499, Harlingen, TX
parking: Lot inside Hugh Ramsey Nature Park at the south end.
note: Follows a canal north to Rio Hondo Rd.

name: Harlingen Rotary Bark Park
addr: 1601 S M St, Harlingen, TX
note: Fenced, off leash, with separate big and small dog areas and water fountains. 2 dogs per person, no digging. Dawn to dusk.

name: A Piece of Cake by Ybarra's
addr: 202 E Harrison Ave, Harlingen, TX
note: Bakery with outdoor tables.

name: Heavin Resaca Trail
addr: Diaz St and Combes St, San Benito, TX
parking: Parking on Diaz St at Combes St.
note: Runs along the resaca between Bus. 77 and Expressway 83.

name: Laguna Atascosa Wildlife Refuge
addr: Visitor Center, Ocelot Rd, Los Fresnos, TX
miles: 0.9 miles (Visitor Center trails) up to 6+ miles
surface: Visitor Center trails are paved. Most others are dirt or caliche.
parking: Lot at the Visitor Center. Prairie Trail (4.1 mile loop) has a lot off FM 106 just west of San Roman. Entrance fee.
note: Leashed dogs welcome. Alligators live here, so keep dogs away from the water. Check hunting season dates before you go.

name: Los Fresnos Nature Park
addr: 851 N Arroyo Blvd, Los Fresnos, TX
note: Nature park with a walking trail. The Historic Battlefield Trail from Brownsville ends here.

name: South Padre Island beaches
addr: Gulf Circle Beach Access #3, South Padre Island, TX
note: Leashed dogs are allowed on city beaches all year. 24 beach access points along Gulf Blvd with free parking. Gulf Circle (#3) and Treasure Island Circle (#11) have restrooms and showers. Pick up after your dog and skip hot midday sand.

name: Laguna Madre Nature Trail
addr: SPI Convention Centre, 7355 Padre Blvd, South Padre Island, TX
parking: Free lot at the Convention Centre.
note: Boardwalk over the marsh by the bay. Great at sunset.

name: Lobo Del Mar Cafe
addr: 204 W Palm St, South Padre Island, TX
note: Outdoor tables by the water. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

name: Longboard Bar & Grill
addr: 205 W Palm St, South Padre Island, TX
note: Outdoor tables with a water view.

name: Clayton's Beach Bar & Grill
addr: 6900 Padre Blvd, South Padre Island, TX
note: Big outdoor area on the beach. Live music.

name: Padre Island Brewing Co
addr: 3400 Padre Blvd, South Padre Island, TX
note: Porch tables.

name: Wanna-Wanna Beach Bar & Grill
addr: 5100 Gulf Blvd, South Padre Island, TX
note: Beachfront patio.

name: Cafe Karma
addr: 5200 Padre Blvd, South Padre Island, TX
note: Coffee shop with an outdoor patio.

name: KIC's Ice Cream
addr: Amberjack St, South Padre Island, TX
note: Outdoor seating and a pup cup.
